question.text: A particle of mass $m$ is attached to a spring (of spring constant $k$ ) and has a natural angular frequency $\omega_0$. An external force $F(t)$ proportional to $\cos \omega t\left(\omega \neq \omega_0\right)$ is applied to the oscillator. The time displacement of the oscillator will be proportional to

solution.text:
For forced oscillations, the displacement is given by
$$
\mathrm{x}=\mathrm{A} \sin (\omega \mathrm{t}+\phi) \text { with } \mathrm{A}=\frac{\mathrm{F}_0 / \mathrm{m}}{\omega_0^2-\omega^2}
$$
